bibl.title: Roman Empire and British Imperialism: the Private Archive of J. De M. Johnson's Excavation in Antinoopolis.
bibl.seg: Myrto Malouta, Roman Empire and British Imperialism: the Private Archive of J. De M. Johnson's Excavation in Antinoopolis.
bibl.note: Photographs and documents found in the archive of J. de M. Johnson at Oxford University Press add to our knowledge about his archaeological excavation - focused on finding papyri - at Antinoopolis in 1913/14. This material can also contribute to the discussion regarding the link between archaeology and politics, by offering an illustrative case study of the dependance of the early history of papyrology on British imperialist ideology.
